source: NBC 105:2020 Table 4-3: importance class I (ordinary buildings, I = 1.0), II (buildings with many people, I = 1.25), III (essential facilities: hospitals, schools, fire and police stations, emergency buildings, I = 1.5). The categories I-IV are SAEngine's slots: I and II take class I, III class II, IV class III. The windImportance is the parent's IS 875 (Part 3) class marker.

I.description: Importance class I: ordinary buildings of low occupancy (I = 1.0; wind: the parent's 25-year class)

II.description: Importance class I: ordinary buildings (residences, offices) (I = 1.0)

III.description: Importance class II: buildings with many people (assembly, commercial, large residential) (I = 1.25)

IV.description: Importance class III: essential facilities (hospitals, schools, fire, police and emergency buildings, power and telecommunication) (I = 1.5)
